name: Desecrating Destruction
body:
Items of holy power are particularly satisfying to destroy.

Prerequisite(s): Evil alignment, Improved Sunder or ability to cast break, rune of ruin or shatter.

Benefit(s): You deal additional damage equal to your character level when you successfully sunder a weapon that is good-aligned, a shield or armor that grants DR/evil, or an object with an aura of good. If you deal damage to such an object with another ability, you deal additional damage equal to half your character level. When you inflict the broken or destroyed condition on an item of this kind, you gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and saving throws for 1 minute.
